name: token-conformance
templateLines: - Tokens off the 4/8 rhythm: Space/150 = 6 (12 values); a scale decision, not a defect
- Bind opportunities: <n> values across <n> tokens (table below when any)
- Matched but not offered: <collection> (<n> <reason>), one entry per collection

lineRewrites.from: let MODE = "discover"; // discover | tokens | rhythm // without the token-conformance pack this reads: let MODE = "rhythm"

descriptionSentences: With spacing tokens in the file it audits against those tokens and binds values to the matching variable.
cost: one extra collect call (discover) when the file has tokens; about 22 to 24 credits per page audit either way
